title: Flame Blade

sources.title: Flame Blade
markers: | description = Conjure a flaming {{SmRarityItem|Flame Blade (weapon)|alias=Scimitar}} in your hand for 10 turns that deals {{DamageText|3d6|Fire}} damage. It sheds a bright light in a {{Dist|m=3|ft=10}} radius and a dim light in a {{Dist|m=6|ft=20}} radius.

summary: Conjure a scimitar that deals 3d6 Fire with a melee spell attack.

fields.Spell: Conjure the blade for 10 turns. Casting with a level 4 or 5 slot raises the damage to 4d6. A level 6 slot raises it to 5d6.
fields.Light: Bright light to 10 ft and dim light to 20 ft.
fields.Handling note: Can be equipped in either hand or unequipped into the caster’s inventory. It cannot be thrown or given to someone else.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Attack: 5 ft melee spell attack using the wielder’s spellcasting ability. Deal 3d6 Fire without adding an ability modifier to damage. No Flourish, Lacerate, or other weapon actions.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
